battle.name: 隋平江南之戰
battle.brief: 開皇九年十月隋軍分三路逼近長江，十一月陳後主被擒於建康；開皇十年秋，隋廷發兵嶺南，平蘇寶於晉安、王仲通於番禺，李佛子降於交州，江南乃全。卡面的斯巴達長矛是公元前八世紀希臘方陣的兩米木槍，對位中原裝備是隋軍步槊與長矛，但決定此役的是弩陣、攻城器械與五牙大艦，而非一面槍牆。

kit.name: 斯巴達長矛
kit.history: 兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套。方陣裡它比劍更早決定誰站得住。

countries: 這場戰役的兩方，一邊是南朝陳，陳後主陳叔寶坐鎮建康，倚長江天險與三吳的財賦，麾下有禁軍、各州鎮兵與郡縣部曲，淮南一線由大將吳明徹節制，京口由陳將阮慧死守，采石、姑孰沿江築壘拒守；另一邊是隋文帝楊堅的隋朝，開皇九年以晉王楊廣掛行軍元帥，楊素以尚書左僕射身份實際統兵，賀若弼、韓擒虎分任從容與先鋒，高顥總攬造舟與攻城器械，宇文愷襄理舟械，總兵五十一萬八千人分東、中、西三路進軍。開皇十年春，陳朝殘部與嶺南舊將再起：晉安蘇寶聚兵萬餘自稱領軍，番禺王仲通與陳朝舊將陳佛智內應，交州李佛子據龍編，隋廷再遣將分道剿滅，並拉攏高涼冼夫人與廣州俚族武裝作為地方助力。指揮系統上，隋以行軍元帥府統諸軍，兵部與度支供糧，御史臺與侍御史監軍；陳則以中書省制令，各將軍與刺史各守一隅，號令不出建康，故建康一失，江南各郡無中樞可依，只能各自為戰，終被各路隋軍分化剪滅。
countriesEn: Two sides fought in this war. One was the Chen dynasty of the Southern Dynasties, with Emperor Houzhu Chen Shubao sitting in Jiankang, relying on the Yangtze barrier and on the wealth of the Three Wu regions; under him stood the imperial guard, the garrison troops of the provinces and the departmental troops of the commanderies and counties, with the great general Wu Mingche holding the Huai River line, Chen's general Ruan Hui defending Jingkou to the death, and fortified camps raised along the river at Caishi and Gushu. The other was the Sui of Emperor Wen Yang Jian, who in the ninth year of Kaihuang gave his son Prince Jin Yang Guang the title of supreme commander, had Yang Su — as Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs — actually command the army, appointed He Ruobi and Han Qinhu as reserve and vanguard respectively, and left Gao Jiong in overall charge of building the warships and the siege engines, with Yuwen Kai assisting on the same works: 518,000 men in all were mustered and sent forward on an eastern, a central and a western route. In the spring of the tenth year of Kaihuang the survivors of Chen and former Chen officers rose once more: Su Bao at Jin'an collected more than ten thousand men and styled himself commander of the host, Wang Zhongtong in Panyu was in secret contact with Chen's former general Chen Fozhi, and Li Fozhi occupied Longbian in Jiaozhou; the Sui court once more sent generals along separate routes to destroy them, and drew on the local armed strength of Lady Xian in Gaoliang and of the tribal warriors of the Guangzhou region as partners. On the Sui side the office of the supreme commander directed the several armies, the Ministry of War and the transport office supplied the grain, and the censorate with its travelling inspectors watched the generals. On the Chen side orders were issued from the Secretariat, while each general and provincial governor held his own corner; command never reached past Jiankang, so that once Jiankang fell no central authority was left for the southern commands to obey, each army fought alone, and they were cut up and destroyed one by one by the separate Sui columns.
people: 握有戰略主動權的是隋文帝楊堅。他不親征，而以晉王楊廣掛行軍元帥之號、楊素實際統兵，兼用高顥之謀，形成皇帝在後、猛將在前、參謀在側的結構。楊素是這場戰役真正的工程師：他在益州永建造黃龍、玄熊等大艦，順流東下，所經州縣兵不血刃地掃清江陵以下的沿江據點，逼陳朝放棄上游；賀若弼以廣陵為基地，造大船、備器械，夜令士卒換陳軍旗幟渡江破京口，把偷襲與強攻合為一體；韓擒虎率五百騎乘小舟夜渡，直取石頭城，是全役最鋒利的一擊。陳方以陳後主、蕭摩訶、歐陽頵、阮慧、司馬消難為主，吳明徹是唯一能與隋軍在淮南相持的名將，他在攻彭城失利後傷重而死，淮南防線隨之瓦解，陳廷自此再無人能統一號令。開皇十年的收官，關鍵人物是嶺南的冼夫人：陳佛智來借兵，她拒絕，並遣孫陳佛智率俚兵助隋，又奉隋帝璽書與之交涉，這是隋廷能用有限兵力平定嶺南的原因。
peopleEn: The man holding the strategic initiative was Sui Emperor Wen Yang Jian. He did not campaign in the field himself: he gave his son Prince Jin Yang Guang the title of supreme commander, let Yang Su actually lead the army in the field, and used the plans of Gao Jiong, producing a structure in which the emperor sat at the rear, the fierce generals fought in front and the staff officers worked on the flank. Yang Su was the real engineer of this campaign: at Yongjian in Yizhou he built great ships such as the Huanglong and the Xuanxiong, let them run down the river, and swept the Chen positions below Jiangling off the map without blood being shed, forcing the Chen court to abandon the upper river. He Ruobi used Guangling as his base, built large vessels and siege equipment, and crossed the river at night after ordering his men to change the Chen army's flags, taking Jingkou by uniting a surprise with a frontal assault. Han Qinhu led five hundred cavalry across in small boats by night and struck straight at Shitoucheng, the sharpest blow of the whole war. On the Chen side the leading figures were Emperor Houzhu, Xiao Mohe, Ouyang Tuo, Ruan Hui and Sima Xiaonan; Wu Mingche was the only commander able to hold his own against the Sui in the Huai River region, and when he was defeated before Pengcheng and died of his wound the Huai line collapsed, leaving the Chen court without anyone able to unite the army. The closing phase of the campaign in the tenth year of Kaihuang turned on Lady Xian in Lingnan: when Chen Fozhi came to ask for troops she refused, sent her grandson Chen Fozhi with tribal warriors to aid the Sui, and carried the Sui emperor's sealed letters in the negotiation with him. That was the reason the Sui court could settle Lingnan with a limited force.
kits: 卡面那件斯巴達長矛，是公元前八世紀以後希臘方陣的標準長兵：兩米上下的木槍，槍尾裝著銅套，可以插地撐住盾牌的重量，槍葉只是粗糙的鐵，真正壓死人的是持矛者身後那片相互扶靠的密集隊形。放到這場戰役裡，與它對位的中原兵器是隋軍的長矛與步槊：前鋒以大盾護身、以槊壓陣，後隊以弓弩齊射覆蓋，然後由步卒踏水登岸、攀城破壘。隋軍的投射火力比希臘方陣時代厚得多，班弩、翼善弩與飛石機在渡江與攻城時同時展開，遠程先削弱陳軍的江防射陣，長矛方陣只在最後一段進距離內派上用場。攻城端才是這場戰役真正的重裝：雲梯、撞車、破樓車、鉤援、巢車由高顥、宇文愷督造，江陵、姑孰、晉安諸城都是靠器械加上圍城斷糧才拿下。舟師方面，楊素造五牙大艦，艦上拍竿高十餘丈，另有黃龍、玄熊等大艦與蒙衝、鬥艦配套，船隊連屬江上，兼作浮橋與攻城塔。馬匹是另一條命脈，騎兵、傳令、偵察與追擊都靠馬，軍馬與運糧船隻同樣靠江南既有的供應。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card face, the Spartan dory, was the standard long arm of the Greek phalanx from the eighth century BCE onward: a wooden shaft about two metres long with a bronze butt-spike that could be planted in the ground to take the weight of a shield; the blade itself was only rough iron, and what really killed was the dense line of mutually bracing men behind the spear-points. Set into this campaign, the Central Plains counterpart of that weapon is the Sui army's long spear and step-spear: the vanguard covered itself with large shields and pressed forward with the long spear, the rear ranks covered them with volleys of bow and crossbow, and then the foot soldiers waded ashore and scaled the walls. The Sui's missile fire was far heavier than anything of the phalanx era; the repeating crossbow, the wing crossbow and stone-throwers were all deployed together during the river crossing and the sieges, the long-range fire first thinned the Chen missile line on the river banks, and the spear formation was needed only in the last close-range stretch. The siege side was the real heavy equipment of this campaign: siege ladders, battering rams, tower-breakers, hooked grapples and siege-towers were built under Gao Jiong and Yuwen Kai, and Jiangling, Gushu and Jin'an all fell only through such machines combined with blockade and cutting of the supply route. On the water, Yang Su built the great five-fanged ships with beating poles more than ten zhang high, supported by vessels such as the Huanglong and the Xuanxiong together with ram-ships and fighting galleys; the fleet was lashed together along the river and served as a floating bridge and a mobile siege tower as well. Horses were the other artery of the army: cavalry, messengers, scouts and pursuit parties all depended on them, and the horses and the grain boats drew on the supplies the southern region already had.
tactics: 隋軍的戰術核心是多路同時、舟兵先登、器械破城。開皇九年十月，賀若弼自廣陵、韓擒虎自廬州、楊素自益州永建，三路在同一時段逼近長江各處要點，讓陳朝無法判斷主攻方向；楊素一路以大艦順流，目標不是攻城，而是把陳朝在長江中游的據點逐個拔掉，使下游的京口、建康失去上游屏障與糧源。渡江靠夜襲：韓擒虎以五百騎乘小舟夜渡，賀若弼則在攻京口時夜令士卒換陳軍旗幟，使陳軍誤認援軍為隋兵而潰。登岸之後，隋軍先用弩箭壓住城頭射陣，再用雲梯、破樓車靠上城垣，撞車撞門，同時以封鎖江道斷其糧道，逼守軍在器械與圍困之間被動。陳軍的部署本不弱：采石、姑孰、京口、建康沿江築壘，江防以水軍與弩兵為主，屢次焚燒隋舟，但吳明徹陣亡後，淮南與上游的兵力無法互相策應，前線被各路隋軍切斷，兵愈多而愈難集結。開皇十年的嶺南平叛又換了打法：隋軍不再正面仰攻山城，而是分進合剿、配合地方武裝，冼夫人以俚族兵從側面斷其退路，蘇寶、王仲通、李佛子因而各自孤立，最後被逐一攻破。
tacticsEn: The core of Sui tactics was simultaneous pressure on several axes, landing the fleet first and breaking the walls with machines. In the tenth month of the ninth year of Kaihuang, He Ruobi came from Guangling, Han Qinhu from Luzhou and Yang Su down from Yongjian in Yizhou; the three columns approached the key points on the river within the same stretch of time, so that the Chen court could not tell where the main blow would fall. Yang Su's objective was not to storm cities but to pull out, one by one, the Chen footholds on the middle river, so that Jingkou and Jiankang downstream would lose their upstream screen and their source of supply. The crossing rested on night attacks: Han Qinhu took five hundred cavalry over in small boats by night, and at Jingkou He Ruobi ordered his men to change the Chen army's flags in the dark, so that the Chen troops took the approaching Sui for their own reinforcements and broke. Once ashore, the Sui first pinned the defenders' missile line with crossbow fire, then brought ladders and tower-breakers up against the walls and rammed the gates, while sealing the river to cut the food route, leaving the garrison to choose between the machines and the blockade. The Chen deployment was not weak in itself: camps were raised along the river at Caishi, Gushu, Jingkou and Jiankang, the river defence rested on war-junks and crossbowmen, and the Chen fleet set fire to Sui boats more than once. But after Wu Mingche's death the troops in the Huai valley and those on the upper river could no longer support one another, the front was cut into separate sections by the advancing Sui columns, and the more troops Chen gathered the harder they were to bring together. The suppression of the revolt in Lingnan in the tenth year of Kaihuang used a different method: the Sui no longer assaulted the hill towns head-on, but advanced on several axes and closed in, working with the local armed groups, and Lady Xian's tribal warriors cut the retreat from the flank, leaving Su Bao, Wang Zhongtong and Li Fozhi each isolated and finally broken one at a time.
data: 兵力是這場戰役最硬的數字：隋軍開皇九年所發兵卒，《資治通鑑》記為五十一萬八千人；陳朝方面可集之兵約四十萬。表面是五比三，但隋軍是分進合擊，陳軍是被動分守，所以人數並不直接換來戰果。關鍵的數字還包括：韓擒虎夜渡所領騎兵五百；楊素所造五牙大艦，艦上拍竿高十餘丈，與黃龍、玄熊等艦連屬江上，展開以數十里計；開皇十年反叛的晉安蘇寶聚兵萬餘，交州李佛子據龍編，番禺王仲通與陳佛智在廣州內應，隋廷的援軍則沿江而下。攻城與守城同樣可用數字衡量：隋軍舟師拍竿可及十餘丈高，陳軍沿江連營動輒以十數里計，而糧道一斷，城中存糧即以月計，隋軍背後卻有江淮間運河與長江水路接連的漕運線，可以長期圍而不攻。孫吳以來江南一直是南朝倚仗的賦稅重地，隋平江南之後，隋朝戶口增至極盛時約四百六十萬戶、兩千三百餘萬口，江南的田賦與丁調成為開皇年間國家財政的主要支柱之一；戰後隋文帝下詔免江南徭役數年，這既是安撫，也是耗血之後的暫時回血。
dataEn: The hardest numbers in this campaign are the troop figures: the Sui mustered 518,000 men in the ninth year of Kaihuang, as recorded in the Comprehensive Mirror; the Chen side could bring together about 400,000. On paper that is five to three, but the Sui attacked on several axes while the Chen could only hold in place, so the larger numbers of the south did not translate into results. Among the other decisive figures: the five hundred cavalry Han Qinhu took across the river by night; the great five-fanged ship built by Yang Su, whose beating poles stood more than ten zhang high and which was lashed together with vessels such as the Huanglong and the Xuanxiong along the river, the line of the fleet running for several dozen li; the revolt of the tenth year of Kaihuang, in which Su Bao at Jin'an collected more than ten thousand men, Li Fozhi occupied Longbian in Jiaozhou, and Wang Zhongtong and Chen Fozhi were in contact inside Guangzhou, while the Sui reinforcements came down the river. Siege and defence can be measured in the same way: the beating poles of the Sui fleet reached more than ten zhang, the Chen camps along the river were counted in stretches of a dozen li, and once the supply route was cut the food in a besieged city was counted in months, while behind the Sui lines the canal and the river between the Huai and the Yangtze kept the transport line open, so a siege could be kept up without a storm. Since the time of the Wu, the Jiangnan region had been the fiscal base the southern dynasties relied on; after the Sui pacified it, the Sui population rose at its height to about 4.6 million households and more than 23 million mouths, and the land tax and the poll tax of the south became one of the main pillars of state finance under Kaihuang. After the war Emperor Wen of Sui issued an order remitting the corvée of the Jiangnan region for several years, which was at once pacification and a temporary recovery after the bleeding.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。最遠的一層是南北朝近三百年的分裂：自西晉永嘉之亂起，中原數度易主，江南憑長江與三吳的財富自東晉而後歷宋、齊、梁、陳五朝更替，與北方朝代互有勝負，誰都吞不下誰。第二層是隋文帝楊堅的十年備戰：他在位後休養戶口、儲積糧秣、造舟造器械，並用高顥的離間之策，先遣使分頭招撫陳將蕭摩訶、歐陽頵等人，許以封爵，讓陳廷內部互相猜疑，再於開皇九年正月下詔發兵，使陳人始終不知道主攻方向。第三層是陳朝自身的失政：陳後主營建綺殿、興文教、寵信佞臣，江南大族與中央互相防範，軍紀與財政都空；吳明徹一死，淮南失守，建康遂成孤城。開皇十年殘部的再起，則是因為陳亡之後江南舊將與宗室不甘失敗，既有的部曲與鄉族關係沒有隨著朝廷覆亡而解散，叛亂因此有現成的兵源與地形可用，而隋廷對江南的接管一時又接不上。
causeEn: There were three layers of cause. The farthest one is the nearly three centuries of division between north and south: since the Yongjia disaster at the fall of Western Jin the Central Plain changed hands repeatedly, while the Jiangnan region, resting on the Yangtze and on the wealth of the Three Wu, maintained itself through the Eastern Jin and then through five successive dynasties — Song, Qi, Liang and Chen — each of which won and lost against the northern houses, so that none could swallow the others. The second layer is Emperor Wen Yang Jian's ten years of preparation: once on the throne he let the households recover, filled the granaries, built the warships and the siege machines, and used the stratagem of separation devised by Gao Jiong, first sending envoys separately to sound out such Chen commanders as Xiao Mohe and Ouyang Tuo and offering them titles, so that the Chen court was made to distrust its own men, and only then issuing the order to march in the first month of the ninth year of Kaihuang, leaving the Chen without any idea where the main attack would come from. The third layer is the misgovernment of the Chen itself: Emperor Houzhu built sumptuous halls, promoted literary culture and favoured flatterers, the great families of the south and the central government watched each other suspiciously, and both discipline and finance were hollow; with the death of Wu Mingche the Huai line broke, and Jiankang was left a lone city. The rising of the survivors in the tenth year of Kaihuang came about because, after the fall of Chen, the old generals and the royal house of the south were unwilling to accept defeat, because the existing company and village ties of the troops had not dissolved with the fallen court, and because rebellion therefore found soldiers and terrain ready to hand, while the Sui take-over of the region could not at once be put into effect.
impact: 這場戰役最直接的效果是政治版圖被改寫：陳亡，南朝結束，隋成為唯一的正統王朝，開皇之後的十幾年，北方制度南移，江淮以上的舊族被重新編入國家官僚體系，江南也從割據政權的財賦重地變成王朝的漕運與軍糧基地，開皇年間的繁榮正建立在這次兼併之上。但代價也記在帳上：南朝末年的江南經過侯景之亂與陳末戰亂，士族流散、莊園凋敝，隋初的江南並非立刻繁榮，隋朝不得不用括戶、均田、減賦等手段重建稅基。更遠的影響是國策的轉向：統一之後，隋朝的注意力轉向北方與東北，先後三次進攻高句麗，每一次都從江南調糧，江南的財力與丁役因此被一再抽取，開皇年間的積蓄在隋煬帝末年被消耗殆盡；到隋末，天下大亂，江南又成為割據者爭奪的重鎮。同時這場戰役留下兩個常被後人引用的範例：其一是隋朝以水軍與攻城器械壓倒南朝防禦，說明長江不再是南方可以獨守的屏障，天險要配上船與機械才有意義；其二是陳亡之後仍有殘部在嶺南抵抗一年有餘，說明改朝換代不等於地方秩序立刻重建，安撫與接管同樣是戰爭的一部分。
impactEn: The most direct effect of this campaign was the redrawing of the political map: Chen fell, the Southern Dynasties ended, and the Sui became the single legitimate dynasty. In the years after Kaihuang the institutions of the north moved south, the old clans above the Yangtze and the Huai were reabsorbed into the state's bureaucratic order, and the Jiangnan region changed from the fiscal base of a partitioned regime into the transport and military supply base of the dynasty; the prosperity of the Kaihuang years rested directly on this annexation. The cost is also kept on the ledger: the Jiangnan of the late Southern Dynasties, after the Hou Jing rebellion and the wars at the end of Chen, had seen the great clans scattered and their estates ruined, so the south under the early Sui did not become prosperous at once, and the Sui had to rebuild the tax base by registering households, equalising fields and lightening levies. A more distant effect was the turn in policy: once unified, Sui attention turned north and north-east, and the three campaigns against Goguryeo each drew grain from the south, so the wealth and the labour of Jiangnan were drawn off again and again, until the reserves of the Kaihuang years were exhausted by the end of the reign of Emperor Yang; when the Sui collapsed and the realm broke up, Jiangnan became once more the prize contested by the regional warlords. The campaign also left two examples that later writers cite. The first is that the Sui beat the southern defence with a navy and siege engines, showing that the Yangtze was no longer a barrier a southern state could hold alone: a natural advantage only means something when it is backed by ships and machines. The second is that remnants of Chen still resisted for more than a year in Lingnan after the dynasty fell, showing that a change of dynasty does not rebuild local order at once: pacification and take-over are part of the war as much as the fighting is.
result: 算結果：開皇九年十月三路隋軍同時逼近長江，十一月隋軍入建康，陳後主與張麗華、孔貴嬪躲入景陽殿的井中，終被隋軍士卒拖出，陳朝祚絕，南朝自劉裕受晉禪至此一百六十九年而終。開皇十年，隋廷發兵嶺南，蘇寶在晉安兵敗被斬，王仲通於番禺敗死，交州李佛子降，陳朝舊將陳佛智被押解京師後免死，冼夫人因助隋平叛受封譙國夫人；至此江南與嶺南盡歸隋朝，隋的版圖自北至南連成一體，戰爭以隋的全面勝利告終。從兵器角度看，決定這場戰役的不是任何一件單兵武器：斯巴達長矛那樣的木槍與銅套，在公元前五世紀的希臘足以讓方陣站住，但兩百多里長的水路、沿江的城防與陳朝的弩手，需要的卻是弩、拍竿、雲梯與大艦。勝方用一支整軍看得見、糧道接得上的軍隊贏得了戰役；敗方輸在失去同一樣東西——一個能讓各軍服從的中樞。
resultEn: As to the outcome: in the tenth month of the ninth year of Kaihuang the three Sui columns closed on the Yangtze at the same time; in the eleventh month the Sui entered Jiankang, and Emperor Houzhu, with Zhang Lihua and Kong Guirui, hid in the well of the Jingyang Hall until the Sui soldiers dragged him out. The Chen line ended, and the Southern Dynasties came to an end after a hundred and sixty-nine years, counting from Liu Yu's taking the Jin seal. In the tenth year of Kaihuang the Sui court sent troops into Lingnan: Su Bao was defeated at Jin'an and killed, Wang Zhongtong was destroyed at Panyu, Li Fozhi of Jiaozhou surrendered, Chen's former general Chen Fozhi was brought to the capital and pardoned, and Lady Xian, who had helped the Sui put down the revolt, was ennobled as Lady of Qiao. The Jiangnan region and Lingnan thus came wholly under the Sui, the Sui map ran unbroken from north to south, and the war ended in complete Sui victory. As for arms, no single weapon decided this campaign: a wooden shaft and bronze butt-spike like the Spartan dory was enough to hold a phalanx together in fifth-century Greece, but against two hundred li of river, the walls along its banks and the crossbowmen of Chen, what was needed was the crossbow, the beating pole, the siege ladder and the great ship. The winning side took the field with an army that was visibly in order and whose supply line held; the losing side lost exactly the same thing — a central authority to which all the armies would obey.
